_comment: audit.findings input shape for wp-fix.test.sh. Mirrors what scripts/audit-static.sh and scripts/audit-live.sh actually emit. Absolute `file` paths carry the __ROOT__ placeholder, which the test substitutes with its mktemp sandbox — audit-static.sh:41 resolves ROOT to an absolute host path, so real findings always arrive absolute.

findings._case: supported — confirmed XSS, real line. Note category is code-style, NOT security.
supported — false positive: already escaped via a theme helper. Gate 1 must dismiss this.
supported — ordering pair (low line). Must be applied AFTER line 42.
supported — ordering pair (high line). Must be applied FIRST.
supported — medium severity, filtered out by --severity high.
findings.suggestion: Avoid obfuscation; validate any decoded data.

findings._case: unsupported — a11y is hardcoded line:0 (audit-static.sh:241). No anchor for a diff.
findings.suggestion: Add descriptive alt or alt="" if decorative.

findings._case: unsupported — live perf finding. `file` is a URL, not a path.
findings.suggestion: Optimize hero image, preload critical assets.

findings._case: unsupported — live vuln finding. `file` is plugin/<slug>; remediation is an update.
unsupported — external:true. Third-party code; an edit is reverted by the next update.
findings.message: eval() or equivalent dynamic execution found
findings.suggestion: Remove eval(); use safe parsing or whitelists.

findings._case: unsupported — real line, but not one of the 9 rules. Secrets are rotated, not patched.
findings.suggestion: Rotate the secret and remove it from source control.
